title: HUNTIQDatasetManifest
description: Standard schema for versioned dataset manifests in the HUNTIQ AI data platform

manifest_id.description: Unique manifest identifier (UUID or semantic format)

dataset_name.description: Machine-readable name of the dataset (e.g., search_intent_ethiopia)

version.description: Semantic version of the dataset release

source_export_id.description: Deterministic identifier or hash of the authoritative backend export

record_count.description: Total number of sample records in the dataset

sha256_checksum.description: SHA-256 hash of the processed dataset file

pii_scrubbed.description: Explicit attestation that all PII (phone numbers, emails, passwords) has been scrubbed

metadata.description: Optional domain metadata, notes, or licensing info
